verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail documents its own APIs for connecting the virtual mailbox to other tools and keeping documents and mail in sync. Nothing shows the API covers UI actions such as forwarding, check deposit, shredding, junk filtering, user access management or AI labels, so only a thin, sync-oriented API is evidenced. Missing for 10: API reference documentation, evidence of UI-to-API parity for mail actions (forward, scan, shred, deposit), account and user management via API, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Use APIs to connect your virtual mailbox to the tools you already use, so your documents and mail stay in sync and your work keeps moving.
API integrations to connect your mailbox with the tools you already use
